title: Wizards Play Network 2026: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."
"Did I mention I study martial arts?"
Oriq agents stick to the dark corners of Arcavios, unseen yet ever-present.
"Primarily, I'm a man of science. I'm only a hero by extension."
"My story happens in the silence between the notes. That is where the magic happens. That is where you will find me."
"With but a wave of my hand I shall destroy you forever!" —Doctor Doom
"Throw me at anything—I'll always land on my feet."
After the coming of Humans, the Wood-Elves took ever more and more to the gloaming and the dusk. Still Elves they were and remained—that is, Good People.
"The name of the game is called, uh . . . fizzbin."
"There is nothing shameful about falling before a superior enemy, human!"
"What purpose does emulating humans serve except to remind you that you are incomplete?" —Lal, to Data
Telepathy is a powerful gift, but it leaves Betazoids vulnerable to far more powerful psychic entities.
It glints with arcane truths to those who know how to glimpse them.
"Rejoice, and know all will join you soon." —Calnan, Monoist assassin
